_description: qutebrowser keybindings. Mode → key → command. Maps to home-manager's programs.qutebrowser.keyBindings.<mode> attrset.

normal._comment_autofill: Hotkeys to fire the system autofill daemon directly from a qutebrowser focus context. Browser is just a 'focused window' to the daemon — these hotkeys are the explicit, in-browser ergonomic path on top of the global system hotkey.
